about: The p2x round-2 story film v135-grandma-ev (run 40471230337, r-p2x2te-0002, 2026-10-27; stopped at the film gate, art director fix 8/12, never published) replayed: 1899 the picture of 8 shots, five white cards in a row, QuoteCard and DocCard twice, a Versus and a Standings of years, a LapDelta of two years, French names as the cards' main text, „1899 წელია", „ელექტრო" alone, a speed with no unit. Its hook Film is ci/fixtures/film/V135GrandmaEvHook.tsx (filmlint: SCAN_CONTAIN, INK_ROOM); stories.mjs PHOTO_AGAIN sees its plate twice.

pitches.logline: Belgian Camille Jenatzy wants to pass 100 km/h on a road in 1899. Nobody has done it, and his car runs on something nobody expects.
pitches.hook: FreezeTag on the 1899 plate: a counter rolls 0 to 100 and an ink line snaps as it passes, asmr-count-roll

pitches.logline: I, a know-it-all, believe the electric car is tomorrow's invention, until 1899 Achères and a Belgian with a red beard prove it is older than my grandmother.
pitches.hook: StruckNumber: the word ახალი on the 1899 plate struck in red ink, the year slamming in, asmr-strike
pitches.heroObject: La Jamais Contente on its 1899 plate

pitches.logline: A Belgian everyone calls the Red Devil chases speed in a car named never satisfied, and the hybrid was already coming too.
pitches.hook: KeywordLift of the nickname over the 1899 plate, an ink circle round the seat as an electric whine starts, real-whine

treatment.logline: I, a man sure the electric car is brand new, am proven wrong by 1899 Achères: Jenatzy's electric car passes 100 km/h, and by 1900 Porsche's cars have hub motors and one is among the first hybrids.
treatment.hero: Me, a made-up man sure electric cars are new (the narrator), and La Jamais Contente as the proof
treatment.obstacle: my own belief that the electric car is tomorrow's tech

hook.event: frame 0 reads 2026 big on the paper; from frame 2 it rolls back with a strike sound and lands on 1899, then the word ახალი is struck in red over the 1899 plate

act1: the car is real: near Paris, Belgian Camille Jenatzy drives his electric car
worse: they call him the Red Devil, and the car is called never satisfied
worse still, the twist: in 1899 this electric car passes 105 km/h, faster than any road vehicle before
treatment.turn: the twist on the record shot: the speed counts past the inked 100 line, a 0.7 s hold, at about 40 % of the film

reveal.what: Porsche's 1900 car: motors in the wheels, and one of his cars the first hybrid (ჰიბრიდი slams under the Semper Vivus photo)

treatment.payoff: the same me, changed: electric and hybrid are over 125 years old, not new but a grandma (the EndCard line)
treatment.signature: V135GrandmaEv: the real La Jamais Contente as a plate, its speed counting up through real values past an inked 100 line
treatment.heroObject: La Jamais Contente on its 1899 plate
